description: Election Commission - Mr. M. M. M. Museen of the Kurunegala P/S has vacated his office of member of hat P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to ceasing membership in a political party. It is issued under Section 10 A(1)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and is published in the section for "Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance." This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of an elected official, fitting the definition of an Elections Gazette.
